class.name: TouchpadManager
class.description: A class for managing Windows Precision Touchpad raw input.

method.name: get_device_list
method.description: Returns a list of connected devices.

method.name: get_touch_position
method.description: Returns a touch position at a specified index.

method.name: replace_window_procedure
method.description: Replaces the window prodecure of the provided window handle.

method.name: register_touchpads
method.description: Registers touchpads to the current window.

method.name: update_touchpad_inputs
method.description: Reads the raw touchpad inputs and updates the touch position values.
